invitations_email_lower.name: invitations_email_lower
invitations_email_lower.value: "invitations"."email" = lower("invitations"."email") AND char_length("invitations"."email") between 3 and 254 AND "invitations"."email" like '%_@_%'

invitations_accepted_fields.name: invitations_accepted_fields
invitations_accepted_fields.value: ("invitations"."status" = 'accepted') = ("invitations"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

tax_rates_price_range.name: tax_rates_price_range
tax_rates_price_range.value: ("tax_rates"."price_min_paise" IS NULL OR "tax_rates"."price_min_paise" >= 0) AND ("tax_rates"."price_max_paise" IS NULL OR "tax_rates"."price_max_paise" > coalesce("tax_rates"."price_min_paise", 0))

settings_gstin_matches_registration.name: settings_gstin_matches_registration
settings_gstin_matches_registration.value: ("settings"."gstin" IS NOT NULL) = ("settings"."gst_registration" IS NOT NULL AND "settings"."gst_registration" <> 'unregistered')

settings_gstin_matches_state.name: settings_gstin_matches_state
settings_gstin_matches_state.value: "settings"."gstin" IS NULL OR ("settings"."state_code" IS NOT NULL AND left("settings"."gstin", 2) = "settings"."state_code")
